label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
Here's a draft — sending it to her only, not the group:

---

Bethan, hiya — messaging you on the quiet, not replying all.

I've just landed back from Lagos and my head's all over the place, but I wanted to have a proper word with you before you do anything drastic.

Two things first. Nia's wedding's 17th April at Margam and you're doing the reading — I'd be gutted for that to get tangled up in all this. And Nia rang me last week, crying, asking if you were still coming. She still doesn't know you've stepped back.

Here's what I can sort. You don't have to do the whole weekend. If the cottage on Friday's too much, come for Saturday. There's a train from Cardiff Central, about two and a half hours, and if you're in by six I'll come and pick you up from the station and bring you over. You can kip in with me Saturday night, I've got the twin room. The meal's at Caffi Harbwr at 7.30 so you'd be there in good time — and if you'd rather join the paddleboarding you could get an earlier train and I'll pick you up either way.

I should tell you, I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry at work to get this weekend off. It cost me a night stop I was really gutted to miss, so I'd like it to be worth it, you know what I mean.

The thing at Lowri's 40th in November was a right old mess, and you both said things that night. But she's not one for grudges, she's just stubborn as anything, same as you — I think she's genuinely sorry. Give it a chance.

One practical thing: hang on before you send Lowri the £85. If fewer of us are there Friday night the cottage split might change, and I'd rather we sorted that out first.

Honestly Bethan, come for Saturday. You sat with Nia every night in the Heath when her mam was bad in 2019. She'll remember that, and she'll remember who was in the room.

Siân x

---

Kept it warm rather than lecturing, no taking sides on the November row, and I've left out the "Beth will regret it" bit so it doesn't read as a warning — the Nia stuff does that job on its own.
